decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The reporting centre is a high trip generating use, which fails to provide adequate parking provision for visitors, and by reason of its inappropriate out-of-town centre location, is not readily accessible by sustainable modes of transport. The use has resulted increased parking on nearby streets including the footway and created conditions prejudicial to the free-flow and safe movement of pedestrians and motorists, contrary to policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), E.1.5 (Development Involving Loss or Changes in Employment), T.1.2 (The Movement Implications of Development) and T.1.4 (Car & Cycle Parking and Servicing Facilities for Developments) of the Adopted Unitary Development Plan.

Condition : 2 - The reporting centre is an unneighbourly use which has resulted in harm to the living conditions of nearby residents, by reason of increased activity and disturbance resulting from the comings and goings of visitors in this predominantly residential area contrary to policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and E.1.5 (Development Involving Loss or Changes in Employment), of the Adopted Unitary Development Plan.
description: Continued use of part of ground floor of premises as Home Office Reporting Centre. (Circular 18/84)
